title: Private Zodiac Whale Watching Tour from Victoria
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Operates rain or shine, please dress appropriately
Not suitable for participants with pre-existing neck or back injuries and/or health conditions
This experience requires good ocean conditions. If it is cancelled due to poor conditions, you will be offered a different date or a full refund.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Immerse yourself in the majestic beauty of the Pacific Ocean and experience the world’s best location to view whales in the wild on a three-hour private tour from Victoria, British Columbia. The Juan de Fuca and Haro Strait are renowned for their ample wildlife, including animals such as transient Killer Whales, Humpback Whales, Minke Whales, seals, sea lions and many marine birds!

Zodiac vessel tours are for the more wild at heart, letting the wind blow in your hair and be exposed to the true west coast elements in an open style, 12 passenger vessel.
